meta.name: Review
meta.description:
A review of a movie, or a restaurant, or a car—or whatever else that typically falls under a critic's domain—is all well and good, and can even be helpful at times. But how can one find out about myriad other experiences that are never tackled in reviews? Enter Forrest MacNeil, a critic who goes beyond overviews of life's more-common subjects—way beyond—to satisfy the curiosity of others: The adrenaline rush of stealing; the danger of drug addiction; the delight of sleeping with a celebrity. MacNeil tries anything suggested by viewers of his TV show, then presents a 1-to-5-star review. But his unwavering commitment to experiencing intense adventures means he must deal with the unintended consequences of such a goal.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 6 Mar 2014 · United States of America · Language: English · 23 min
Studio: Abso Lutely Productions, Andrew Daly Productions, Comedy Central · Network: Comedy Central

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9 | S2 10/10 | S3 3/3

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Stealing, Addiction, Prom
videos.overview: Forrest is requested to review shoplifting, cocaine addiction, and going to the prom (although he is in his forties).

videos.title: Sex Tape, Racist, Hunting
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences including making a sex tape, being a racist, and hunting.

videos.title: Pancakes, Divorce, Pancakes
videos.overview: Forrest hits rock bottom after divorcing Suzanne and forcing himself to eat an unhealthy number of pancakes.

videos.title: Celebrity, Batman
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences including sleeping with a celebrity and being Batman.

videos.title: Best Friend, Space
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences including having a best friend and going to space.

videos.title: Road Rage, Orgy
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences that include road rage and going to an orgy.

videos.title: Revenge, Getting Rich, Aching
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences that include revenge, getting rich quick, and being institutionalized.

videos.title: Marry, Run, Party
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences including getting married, running from the law, and being the life of the party.

videos.title: Quitting, Last Day, Irish
videos.overview: Critic Forrest MacNeil reviews real-life experiences including quitting your job, Carpe Diem, and being Irish.

videos.title: Bare-Knuckle Brawl, Blackmail, Glory Hole
videos.overview: Forrest gets into a fight with a stranger, blackmails his new girlfriend and discovers the pleasures of a glory hole.

videos.title: Curing a Gay, Joining the Mile-High Club
videos.overview: Forrest attempts to turn a young gay man straight and finds that having sex on an airplane is surprisingly difficult.

videos.title: Falsely Accused, Sleep With Your Teacher, Little Person
videos.overview: Forrest gets framed for a crime, has sex with a high-school teacher, and experiences the life of a little person.

videos.title: Cult, Perfect Body
videos.overview: Forrest starts a cult and tries to sculpt a perfect body by undergoing a series of enhancements.

videos.title: Catfishing, Haunted House
videos.overview: Forrest reconnects with an ex on his first foray into catfishing and discovers different kinds of ghosts while sleeping in a haunted house.

videos.title: William Tell, Grant A Wish, Rowboat
videos.overview: Forrest sits in a rowboat; convinces his father to re-create William Tell's archery feat; and reluctantly grants his son's birthday wish.

videos.title: Buried Alive, Giving Six Stars, Public Speaking
videos.overview: Forrest spends a day in a coffin; wonders what to do with a request for a six-star rating; and makes a public-speaking appearance.

videos.title: Murder, Magic 8-Ball, Procrastination
videos.overview: Forrest allows a Magic 8-Ball to dictate his decisions for a day, runs into a paradox when faced with the task of procrastinating and faces his toughest review yet.

videos.title: Being Happy, Pillow Fight, Imaginary Friend
videos.overview: Forrest reviews always being happy ("Happiness"), "Pillow Fights" and having an "Imaginary Friend"

videos.title: Conspiracy Theory
videos.overview: Forrest makes a disconcerting discovery while researching conspiracy theories and finds himself on the run from a man-hunter.

videos.title: Locorito, Pet Euthanasia, Dream
videos.overview: After surviving last season's big fall, Forrest gets back to work by reviewing a Mexican restaurant's new product, the experience of putting a pet to sleep and what it's like to live his dream.

videos.title: Co-Host, Ass-Slap, Helen Keller, Forgiveness
videos.overview: Forrest swaps roles with A.J., tries to live like Helen Keller and visits Suzanne to review forgiveness.

videos.title: Cryogenics, Lightning, Last Review
videos.overview: Forrest sets out to cryogenically freeze himself and get struck by lightning, then receives a surprising message from Suzanne.

meta.slogan: Life: it's literally all we have. But is it any good?
